description: This file defines the ThemeDao class, which provides database access methods for theme-related entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions for saving themes, retrieving themes and partial themes by name, deleting themes, and fetching theme images based on image keys and theme names.

classes.name: ThemeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for Themes, providing CRUD operations and theme-specific queries.

methods.name: saveTheme
methods.description: Persists a Theme entity to the database and returns the same entity.

methods.name: getThemeByThemeName
methods.description: Retrieves a Theme entity by its name, defaulting to the system's default theme.

methods.name: getPartialThemeByThemeName
methods.description: Fetches a partial representation of a theme by name, returning a PartialTheme DTO.

methods.name: deleteThemeByThemeName
methods.description: Deletes themes matching the given name and returns the number of affected rows.

methods.name: getImageByImageKeyAndThemeName
methods.description: Retrieves a ThemeImage DTO based on the image key and theme name, or null if not found.
